# integrity/unused-suppression

Suppression that no longer matches a finding.

An ubon-ignore comment whose rule no longer reports anything on that line. Reported in full audits (`--all`) only.

- Default level: `warn`.
- Looks at: each file in scope, on its own.

## Why it matters

Stale suppressions hide future findings on the same line and make the list of accepted risks harder to review.

## How to fix

Remove the comment.

## If the finding is wrong

Add a comment on the line above, in the comment syntax of the file, that says who decided and why:

```
ubon-ignore integrity/unused-suppression: <who decided>: <evidence>
```

Or turn the rule off for the project in `ubon.json`: `"rules": { "integrity/unused-suppression": "off" }`. See [configuration](../../config.md).
